```json
{
  "output_quality": {"score": 4, "reason": "Competent flat-cartoon illustration: horses, jockeys, grandstand, tote board and checkered finish post all read clearly; gradients are clean and nothing is blank or malformed. Bodies are a bit crude and the gray/palomino pair collides awkwardly, but the drawing is appealing and deliberate."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 4, "reason": "Nearly all hard requirements met: standalone 1200x800 SVG, no external assets/JS, four distinct coats/silks with visible numbers, animated legs/dust/manes/tails, grandstand with crowd dots, roof, three flags, tote board, finish post with beam camera, bunting. Misses literally: the track is brown dirt, not turf."},
  "creativity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Charming race-day flourishes beyond the generic: a TOTE // ODDS board with named runners (DAZZLER 4/1, COMET 7/2, SHADOW 11/1), 'RACE DAY' and 'PHOTO FINISH' bunting, a red-lit finish-beam camera post, foreground rail for depth, staggered loop speeds per horse."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Motion genuinely works: across captures horses translate along the track at differing speeds (chestnut left to centre, bay closing on the wire), legs alternate gallop poses and dust puffs trail hooves. Loop is short (~3.5s), so the 3800ms frame snaps horses back before the finish, and they bunch/overlap near the post."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 5, "reason": "Genuinely dense layering: gradient sky with sun glow, three drifting clouds, hills/treeline, two-tier dotted crowd, red roof with flags, detailed tote board, dashed lane markings, double rails front and back, checker finish, bunting, plus gradients/pattern/clipPath. Background and depth cues everywhere."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 4, "reason": "Balanced framing — grandstand upper-left versus tote board and sun upper-right, horses strung across the lanes, bunting arc softening the top edge; harmonious blue/red/green/ochre palette. The thick checkered column dominates the middle-right and the finish-line pile-up slightly muddies legibility."},
  "summary": "A lively, well-layered, genuinely animated race-day scene that nails the brief's motion and detail demands, docked mainly for a dirt-brown 'turf' track, a short loop that visibly snaps horses back, and minor clutter at the finish."
}
```
